# raff_snapshot (Resource)

Captures a point-in-time snapshot of a VM disk or a volume. Mirrors the digitalocean_droplet_snapshot / digitalocean_volume_snapshot pattern — once taken, Terraform owns the snapshot lifecycle (rename / delete).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Snapshot display name. Updates trigger a rename.
- `resource_type` (String) Source type: vm or volume.

### Optional

- `vm_id` (String) Source VM UUID. Required when resource_type=vm.
- `volume_id` (Number) Source volume ID. Required when resource_type=volume.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `size` (String)
- `status` (String)
